label: Vacancies page archetype
reference_archetype: Generic practice vacancies page listing doctor/nurse opportunities with realistic wording.
reference_url_note: Register row S1 structural reference only; content 100% invented.
edge_cases: Doctor vacancy uses 'Immediate start' — wording shows value with publication context, NOT proof of live availability (no vacancy date anywhere on page).
Nurse vacancy lists role category (RN) with published qualification wording ('Full AHPRA registration'), which must be kept as published text.
One entry explicitly says applications are closed — negative case so the reviewer sees a clear non-candidate.
synthesis_rationale: Provides the doctor/nurse vacancy extraction archetype with status-ambiguity and role-category-classification cases.
html:
Work with us

General Practitioner — Immediate start

We are seeking a VR-qualified General Practitioner for our Cassandra Heights practice. Flexible sessional arrangements; on-site support and existing patient panel. Immediate start available for the right candidate.

To apply, email your CV to practice.jobs@alara-park.example.com; enquiries by phone to the practice manager on (07) 5550 0100 only (recruitment enquiries, not clinical).

Applicants must hold current AHPRA registration.

Registered Nurse (RN) — Casual pool

Registered Nurses are wanted for a casual pool covering clinic days and Saturday mornings. You must be AHPRA-registered with demonstrated immunisation experience.

Apply per the address above.

Reception — applications closed

The December reception intake has closed. We thank all applicants and will not receive further CVs for this round.

We do not collect applications through third-party portals.
